value.rationale: The full sharp first-IRC boundary on the natural complete bipartite family isolates both the unique minimal cyclic graph and population composition and an exact universal \(2/5\) preference-phase transition. It distinguishes convergence from mere existence of an equilibrium and supplies a useful small-size obstruction to potential-function arguments, rather than an arbitrary isolated numerical example.
